title: Standard Operating Procedure: Hot Work Near Hydrocarbon Lines
scope: This procedure covers all hot work activities (welding, cutting, grinding) within 15 meters of equipment containing or previously containing hydrocarbons.

steps.action: Obtain Hot Work Permit (PTW) from Control Room Supervisor
Confirm gas test shows <1% LEL in work area. Gas test valid for 4 hours maximum.
Verify equipment isolation (Double Block and Bleed). Check isolation certificate.
Position fire extinguisher and fire watch personnel. Minimum 2 DCP extinguishers (10 kg).
Commence hot work. Continuous gas monitoring required. Stop work if LEL exceeds 10%.

emergency_procedure: In case of fire/gas leak: Stop work immediately -> Activate area alarm -> Evacuate to Assembly Point B -> Call Emergency: Ext 999
